newsitem.title: USA: Interstate Bakeries sales up after purchase.
newsitem.headline: Interstate Bakeries sales up after purchase.

text.p: Interstate Bakeries Corp said Monday its purchase of Continental Baking Co helped its second quarter earnings per share climb 300 percent.
Earnings per share reached $0.69, compared to $0.16 one year ago. Sales climbed 3.2 percent to $758 million.

Interstate Baking officials said an emphasis on the sale of higher-margin products, continued focus on controlling costs and an aggressive brand-building effort also contributed to the improved showing in the second quarter.
Interstate Bakeries is the nation's largest wholesale baking company with 63 operating units nationwide.
